comparison.objective: Hold a seedling upright while adding soil, then release it self-supporting; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization with granular pouring versus counterholding, hex-key use, collar rotation and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Seedling centered/upright with enough soil and released versus safe repeatable stops and retained mechanical setting.
comparison.reason: Shared stabilization is generic; planting tests support construction with many loose bodies rather than commissioning. Candidate omits numeric rebound, overload, drift and torque thresholds.
